title: Product Designer (UX/UI, Consumer Web Focus)
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced spoken English level (B2–C1 or higher).


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.


Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.


Missão da função


Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.


Reporte e interfaces


  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno


Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)


  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.


Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial


  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.


Negociação e fechamento


  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.


Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado


  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.


Metas e indicadores (referência)


  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.


Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).


Exclusividade e conflito de interesses


  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.


Modelo de remuneração


  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.


Suporte da Mobiis


  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: Privacy Counsel (Full Time, Remote Position)
description:
About VeraSafe:

VeraSafe is an innovative and successful U.S. headquartered privacy and cybersecurity compliance consulting firm and law firm. Due to rapid growth and increased demand for our international privacy and technology compliance and legal services, VeraSafe is seeking creative, motivated, and collaborative attorneys to join our team, regardless of prior work experience or education background. This is a fully remote position and will remain a fully remote position.


Watch / listen to learn more about VeraSafe: Check out our podcast!

Apple Podcast :

YouTube :

Spotify:


VeraSafe is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work©, with 96% of our employees affirming that we are truly a great place to work . This means we foster trust, collaboration, and a positive work environment. We are committed to maintaining this standard of meaningful work, work-life balance, and a supportive community. Check out our great benefits, listed at the end of this job description.


VeraSafe frequently hires for attorney and consultant positions on a rolling basis. We are growing rapidly and seek to proactively build a strong talent pool to meet sustained, increasing client demand.


About the Role:

This is an excellent opportunity for an attorney with 4-6 years of experience who wants to join a team working on the cutting edge of privacy and data protection, and who wants to further develop a practice in an in-demand, high-tech area of law. We are inundated with business from clients who love the way we advise on privacy compliance (hence the need for you!).


While this role requires professional experience in privacy law , we are prepared to welcome you to our team with a robust and established onboarding and training process. We typically advance people more quickly than your typical law firm, and we do it on an individual basis (no lockstep promotions or compensation).


Note : We include skills assessments in the recruitment for this position. We know this is a burden, but we think it’s worth it, and we appreciate you taking the time to complete it. We’ve found it enables us to find the best attorneys, regardless of their experience, where they went to law school, or where they were trained. We want smart, kind, creative lawyers, plain and simple, and this assessment is a crucial part of our ability to hire this way.


We are not your typical legal job. We use project managers to keep our remote team organized and our projects streamlined and on-track. We encourage our team members to travel and to make use of our ability to work as digital nomads, whether that means spending a few months abroad or on extended trips to be near family. We collaborate closely (you won’t feel like you’re working in isolation) and we actively encourage sharing of credit for work well done, resources, and advice (and penalize the reverse). We are not biglaw. We do top-notch work for interesting clients, yet we pride ourselves on our team members being happy, with time and energy for a life outside of work, which we believe makes us better attorneys who don’t burn out.


The bottom line: If you want to learn or go deeper practicing privacy law, if you want to practice in a problem-solving environment focused on giving excellent and yet actionable advice, if you want to work with a global team of friendly, brilliant people, if you want the flexibility to work in a way that makes sense to you, please apply!


Responsibilities Include:

  • Assessing client information systems for compliance with data protection laws and regulations
  • Drafting data protection agreements, addenda, and amendments
  • Advising clients on privacy-related product improvements
  • Researching legal issues and composing legal opinions/memoranda
  • Writing privacy law related articles and blog posts
  • Assisting in the development of in-house legal templates
  • Contributing to the development of internal procedures and methodologies
  • Collaborating with a team of intellectual peers who value cooperation and community


What We Need From You

Need to Have:

  • License to practice law (active and in good standing) in your jurisdiction
  • Experience in privacy/data protection of 4-6 years or experience in the field of life sciences of at least 4 years
  • Team player, interested in contributing to a growing enterprise
  • Strong writing/editing skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work remotely
  • Willingness to learn new skills and receive direction and feedback from partners
  • Willingness to pursue privacy certifications (e.g., CIPP/E, CIPM)


Nice to Have:

  • Experience working in a law firm
  • Previous contract drafting and negotiation experience
  • Privacy certifications of some kind (e.g., CIPP/E, CIPP/US, specialty from law school, etc.)
  • Professional involvement in the privacy and/or data security space (attendance at privacy conferences; membership or publication in the IAPP, etc.)


Key Competencies:

  • Detail-oriented and highly organized with a strong work ethic
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable using a variety of software applications
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage your own schedule in order to work successfully with international teams and meet deadlines
  • Ability to work independently and fully deliver on all commitments


VeraSafe’s Excellent Benefits Include:

  • Work from almost anywhere with Wi-Fi
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid holidays
  • Annual bonuses
  • Membership in the International Association of Privacy Professionals (IAPP) and IAPP exam fee reimbursement (CIPP/E)
  • Flexible working schedule in some roles
  • Reimbursement for certain personal flight ticket
  • Company laptop provided


Other Benefits:

  • Tremendous professional development growth opportunities in the privacy, data protection, and cybersecurity niche
  • The chance to have a long-lasting effect on a small but growing international business
  • Work in an open environment with a team that respects your ideas and contributions
  • Occasional opportunities to travel in North America and Europe

title: Data Tech Lead
description:
Estamos procurando uma pessoa de tecnologia de dados experiente e inovador para liderar a estratégia de dados e a execução técnica. Esta função envolve liderar uma equipe de profissionais de dados, discutir arquiteturas de dados robustas e garantir a entrega de soluções de dados escaláveis e de alta qualidade que impulsionam a inteligência de negócios e a eficiência operacional.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Liderar e orientar uma equipe de engenheiros de dados, cientistas de dados e analistas de dados, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alto desempenho.
  • Discutir a arquitetura geral de dados, incluindo armazenamento de dados, data lakes, processos ETL/ELT e estruturas de governança de dados, considerando a escala ideal e o tempo de lançamento no mercado.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados escalonáveis e confiáveis usando tecnologias apropriadas (por exemplo, Python, SQL, Spark, Kafka).
  • Colaborar com produtos, engenharia, e equipes de negócios para entender os requisitos de dados e traduzi-los em soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e segurança dos dados em todas as plataformas e sistemas de dados.
  • Impulsionar a adoção das melhores práticas em engenharia de dados, modelagem de dados e operações de dados.
  • Avaliar e recomendar novas tecnologias, processos e ferramentas para aprimorar e acelerar nossos componentes e capacidades de dados.
  • Solucionar problemas e resolver problemas complexos relacionados a dados, otimizando o desempenho e a confiabilidade.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências do setor e os avanços em tecnologias e metodologias de dados.
  • Contribuir para o planejamento estratégico de iniciativas de dados e roteiro de dados de longo prazo.


REQUISITOS DO CARGO:

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Inglês fluente ou avançado;
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, arquitetura de dados ou função semelhante com foco em dados, com pelo menos 2 anos em capacidade de liderança técnica.


  • Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência liderando projetos de dados.


  • Forte proficiência em SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação comumente usada em engenharia de dados (por exemplo, Python, Scala, Java).


  • Ampla experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (Azure e Databricks) e seus respectivos serviços de dados. (por exemplo, Spark, Hadoop, Kafka) é altamente desejável.


  • Capacidade comprovada de liderar, orientar e inspirar uma equipe técnica.


  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, interpessoais e de resolução de problemas.


  • Forte pensamento analítico e uma abordagem baseada em dados para a tomada de decisões.

title: Technical Business Analyst
description:
About You

You are a technical, AI-enabled Business Analyst who thrives in complex, integration-driven environments. You feel comfortable operating within mature platforms that support a growing ecosystem of external technology partners.

You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in communication. You are curious about AI capabilities and comfortable experimenting with prompt-driven solutions to improve documentation, workflows, and integrations.   • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Technical Business Analyst supporting integration-heavy platforms.
  • Strong experience collaborating closely with Engineering teams in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Hands-on experience managing backlogs using Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar tools.
  • Advanced understanding of APIs and web technologies, including REST, JSON, authentication, error handling, and request/response flows.
  • Experience reviewing logs, analyzing defects, and supporting production issue triage.
  • Experience onboarding and supporting external API or integration partners.

  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Full professional proficiency in English.
  • Familiarity with Azure cloud environments.
  • Exposure to middleware, API platforms, or integration layers.
  • Experience improving onboarding or operational workflows through automation (nice to have, embedded as we usually do).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary coordination point between Engineering teams and external API/integration partners.
  • Own the intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical defects and enhancement requests.
  • Translate business and partner needs into detailed technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the onboarding of new integration partners, including requirement validation, credential setup, testing coordination, certification, and go-live support.
  • Collaborate with Engineering to analyze API logs, error patterns, and production issues to determine root causes and define next steps.
  • Maintain and groom integration-related backlogs, ensuring clarity, prioritization, and delivery alignment.
  • Coordinate UAT and partner validation activities.
  • Track dependencies, risks, and delivery progress across concurrent initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, issue triage, and integration processes through standardization and AI-driven efficiencies.
  • Ensure delivered solutions meet technical constraints, business objectives, and partner expectations.


Qualifications

  • Technical Business Analyst in Agile environments, supporting API integrations (REST, JSON, Authentication, Error Handling), backlog management (Azure DevOps / Jira), defect triage, and production support.
  • Experience supporting external API partners, collaborating cross-functionally with Engineering teams, and leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, and workflow efficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

In this role, you will support infrastructure operations for a suite of software products by managing permissions, handling access requests via Slack, and troubleshooting one-off operational issues as they arise. title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.


The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.


Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.


Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.

title: Analista de Reforma Tributária Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
  • Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Apoiar revisões fiscais de contratos;
  • Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
  • Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
  • Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
  • Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);
  • Desejável Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Planejamento Fiscal ou Direito Tributário;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas fiscais e ERPs SAP Diferencial.

title: Billing Analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.


Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
  • Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
  • Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
  • Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
  • Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
  • Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
  • Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
  • Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
  • Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
  • Professional proficiency in English.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
  • Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
  • Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
  • Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments.


Our compensation package:

- Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT).

- Profit Sharing.

- Transportation vouchers.

- Meals vouchers.

- Health and Dental insurance.

- Birthday day off.

- Gympass / Totalpass.

Differentials

Benefits

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

title: Alloy Welder
description:
Position

The alloy welder is responsible to perform preparation, cleaning, handling, welding, brazing, and cutting using gas and electric welding machines, torches, grinders and other welding craft-related equipment to produce the end product on high alloy materials.

  • Varying degrees of precision and control is required.
  • Support assembly functions as required by the Production Manager.
  • Offsite/offshore travel as required.

Must successfully complete welding tests to perform job duties.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência sólida na gestão de projetos complexos e multifuncionais, conduzindo iniciativas do planejamento à entrega, com foco em previsibilidade, eficiência e valor para o negócio;
  • Vivência consistente na gestão de métricas estratégicas e operacionais de projetos, com foco em performance, previsibilidade e geração de valor;
  • Domínio de metodologias de gestão de projetos preditivas e ágeis, com capacidade de adaptação conforme o contexto e a maturidade do time;

  • Excelente organização e planejamento, assegurando eficiência operacional e cumprimento de prazos;

  • Proatividade, senso de responsabilidade e forte orientação à entrega contínua de valor para o negócio.

title: Financial Controller
description:
Hiring: Financial Controller

Company: Confidential

Reports to: CEO/Owner

Status: Full-time/Contract

Location: Remote (Open to those in Argentina, Brazil, Colombia)


Position Overview

Do you love utilizing forecasts to create strategic, financial insights?

Is creating budgets, reports, and maximizing cash flow your jam?

Are you currently employed as a Controller and eager for more fulfilling employment?


Then we would like to meet you!


A small to medium‑sized financial consulting firm is seeking a Controller who can manage core financial operations and help shape the business as it grows. This role combines traditional accounting oversight with leadership of the delivery team that supports clients with financial consulting services.

You’ll be a strong fit if you work well in a fast‑paced environment, take ownership, and balance strategic thinking with precise execution.

The firm serves small businesses ranging from mid‑six to eight figures in revenue across a variety of industries. In this role, you will support both the firm and its client portfolio, ensuring strong financial systems, clear reporting, and consistent delivery across engagements.

Key responsibilities include financial statements, budgeting and forecasting, internal controls, cash flow, payroll, and financial systems management. You will also help guide the consulting delivery team by overseeing financial processes used in client work and supporting the development of scalable delivery practices.

If you enjoy building structure, improving systems, and partnering with leadership to drive growth, this Controller role will be a great fit.


Responsibilities

  • Prepare Financial Statements: Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, ensuring accuracy and full compliance with US GAAP .
  • Financial Forecasting: Build reliable forecasts to project revenues, expenses, and financial trends for both the firm and client engagements.
  • Ensure Compliance: Maintain adherence to legal, regulatory, and internal accounting policies.
  • Manage Accounting Records: Oversee accurate financial records, including AP, AR, and general ledger management.
  • Implement Controls: Develop and enforce internal controls to safeguard assets and ensure data integrity.
  • Monitor Cash Flow: Track and manage cash flow to support operational needs and strategic initiatives.
  • Optimize Cash Utilization: Create strategies to improve liquidity, cash management, and investment decisions.
  • Support Strategic Planning: Provide financial insights that guide business strategy, growth planning, and decision‑making.
  • Evaluate Financial Performance: Analyze financial results and recommend improvements to achieve organizational and client goals.
  • Oversee Financial Systems: Manage and enhance financial software and reporting systems for efficiency and accuracy.
  • US Payroll Oversight: Manage or review W2 and contractor payroll processes to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.
  • Lead the Delivery Team: Support and guide the financial consulting delivery team, ensuring consistent processes, high‑quality client work, and scalable operational practices.
  • Shape Operational Practices: Contribute to building and refining the firm’s financial delivery frameworks, systems, and internal processes.
  • Client Financial Services Support: Collaborate with consultants to support client financial operations and ensure strong service delivery across engagements.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of Controller or similar experience in finance or accounting
  • 3+ years of leadership experience , ideally overseeing teams or managing financial operations
  • Strong experience with US GAAP financial reporting
  • Experience with US payroll
  • Has a US CPA equivalent for Argentina, Brazil or Colombia
  • Background in client financial services or financial consulting
  • Strong ownership mindset and accountability
  • Action‑oriented and solution‑focused
  • High attention to detail
  • Collaborative and proactive in working with teams
  • Ambitious, driven, and eager to grow
  • Fast learner with strong adaptability
  • Comfortable working in a fast‑paced consulting environment


Additional requirements:

  • Located in Argentina, Brazil, or Colombia
  • Available to work between overlapping hours with 10 AM – 6 PM US Central Time Zone
  • Access to a computer and reliable high‑speed internet
  • Distraction‑free work environment
  • Able to prioritize this role as the primary professional focus
  • Demonstrates accountability, openness to feedback, and strong ownership of work and team contributions
  • Communicates professionally and maintains a clear, respectful tone in all correspondence


Offer Details

  • Pay is relative to the market of the country you live in.
  • This is a full-time contract position


Software Utilized by Company

QuickBooks, Gusto, Microsoft Excel, Slack, Google Suite, ClickUp, Puzzle, Causal


Interview Process

  • Complete application
  • Complete assessment
  • Interview virtually with our US-based recruiting firm
  • Interview virtually with the CEO/owner

title: Senior API Engineer (NodeJS, TS, SDUI)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role summary:

Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You’ll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.


Key responsibilities:

  • Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
  • Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
  • Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
  • Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
  • Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).
  • Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards).
  • Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow.
  • Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility.
  • Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.


Required skills & experience:

  • 7+ years building production microservices and APIs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.
  • Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems.
  • Hands-on development in TypeScript for backend services.
  • Proven RESTful API design and contract experience.
  • Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies.
  • Strong with AWS (API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents).
  • Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers).
  • Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification.
  • Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties.
  • Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.).
  • Good spoken English


Nice to have:

  • Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources.
  • Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts).
  • Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics.
  • Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos).
  • Background in personalization/experimentation systems.
  • Hands-on development in Python for backend services.


Hiring signals:

  • Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements.
  • Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns.
  • Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems.
  • Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

description:

Role Overview

The goal is to shape the reliability and scalability of mission-critical platforms on Azure, Kubernetes , and modern DevOps toolchains. You will solve complex infrastructure challenges, automate end-to-end operations, and ensure systems operate with high availability, performance, and security.


What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure
  • Develop automation frameworks that reduce manual effort and increase consistency.
  • Configure and optimize cloud infrastructure to align with security, scalability, and performance best practices.
  • Collaborate with development teams to remove deployment blockers and improve delivery workflows.

  • Participate in on-call rotations and drive incident resolution with clear postmortems and preventive actions.
  • Maintain technical documentation for pipelines, configurations, and runbooks.
  • Perform readiness assessments and validation tests before production rollouts.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and ARM templates with version control and reproducibility.
  • Troubleshoot complex deployment, provisioning, and performance issues across multi-cloud and containerized environments.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record in SRE or DevOps roles operating production systems
  • Hands-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including cluster design, autoscaling, upgrades, and network policies.
  • Proven CI/CD delivery using GitHub Actions or Jenkins , including promotion across environments, approvals, and rollback strategies.
  • Infrastructure as Code expertise with Terraform and ARM templates, including modules, remote state, workspaces, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automation and diagnostics.
  • GitOps experience with Argo CD or Flux , managing multi-environment application delivery and drift remediation.
  • Containerization with Docker and Kubernetes , including health probes, PodDisruptionBudgets, resource quotas, HorizontalPodAutoscaler, and operators.
  • Networking fundamentals with cloud network security practices such as VNet design, NSGs, Private Link, and ingress controllers.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security and compliance, including least privilege, secrets management, audit trails, and control evidence.
  • Excellent written and spoken English .
  • Ability to collaborate across US time zone .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Azure certification , such as Developer Associate, Administrator, or DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Observability using Application Insights, Elastic Stack (ELK), Grafana, and Prometheus for metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Experience with log aggregation and alerting at scale using Elastic and Prometheus.
  • Understanding of high availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization strategies.
  • Experience managing Windows-based containerized applications .


Plus

  • Experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS

Skyflow is a data privacy vault delivered via APIs. It helps companies isolate, protect, govern, and use sensitive data such as personal, health, or payment information securely, without losing usability. It’s built on a zero-trust architecture, meaning no one gets access to data unless explicitly allowed.

Skyflow is looking for a Platform Engineer to support the SRE team and help design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and infrastructure. This role combines strong backend development skills with knowledge of SRE practices, contributing to the reliability, automation, and optimization of production systems. The Platform Engineer will collaborate closely with SREs, engineers, and business teams to ensure systems are performant, maintainable, and scalable.

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on platform and infrastructure development
  • Experience supporting infrastructure, automation, or reliability practices (SRE exposure is a plus)
  • Proficiency in backend programming languages such as Python or Go
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation), and automation
  • Hands-on experience with RDBMS and distributed systems
  • Ability to work collaboratively with SRE and engineering teams to support production systems

  • Good spoken English


Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code using IaC technologies like Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Write production-grade code (Python or Go) to automate infrastructure management and operational workflows.
  • Establish and enhance observability practices, including metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting.
  • Participate in on-call rotations, incident management, and post-incident reviews to drive continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation to support reliable software delivery.
  • Partner with developers to embed reliability and performance best practices throughout the development lifecycle.


We offer:

title: Senior Data Visualization Engineer
description:
Senior Data Visualization Engineer (Tableau & Databricks Specialist)



Location: Brazil (Remote)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Senior Data Visualization Engineer.



Role Overview


We are seeking a highly autonomous Senior Data Visualization Engineer to lead our business intelligence efforts. As the sole subject matter expert in this space, you will be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of high-impact dashboards—from architectural design in Databricks to final visualization in Tableau .

This is a “team of one” role. You will be the primary consultant to our leadership team, translating complex data into actionable insights without the need for day-to-day technical oversight.



Key Responsibilities


  • End-to-End Ownership: Design, develop, and maintain automated, scalable dashboards and reports.
  • Data Engineering: Write and optimize complex SQL queries within Databricks to transform raw data into performant gold-layer tables.
  • Architecture: Establish best practices for data modeling and dashboard performance tuning to ensure fast load times for large datasets.
  • Strategic Partnership: Collaborate directly with stakeholders to define KPIs and requirements, acting as both the strategist and the executor.
  • Self-Management: Manage the full project lifecycle, including documentation, testing, and deployment, with complete independence.



Required Qualifications


  • Expert Tableau Skills: 5+ years of experience building advanced visualizations (LOD expressions, complex parameters, and API integrations).
  • Databricks Mastery: Proficiency in using Databricks for data processing, including strong SQL skills and familiarity with Delta Lake architecture.
  • Data Modeling: Proven ability to build “analysis-ready” data structures—you know how to join and aggregate data for maximum dashboard efficiency.
  • Independent Problem Solver: A track record of standing up BI functions or working as a solo contributor in a fast-paced environment.
  • Communication: The ability to explain technical data concepts to non-technical executives clearly and concisely.



Preferred Skills


  • Experience with Tableau Server/Online administration.
  • Knowledge of Python or PySpark for advanced data manipulation.
  • Certifications in Tableau Desktop or Databricks Data Engineering.



Why this role is different

Because you will be our only Tableau expert, you won’t be bogged down by “design by committee.” You will have total creative and technical ownership over our BI roadmap and the opportunity to define how this company sees its data.



Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

Project Description:

The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.

  • criteria with stakeholder

  • Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution

description:
We’re looking for a Graphic Designer with strong design fundamentals, an eye for storytelling and the ability to bring visuals to life through motion. You’ll work across social content, digital graphics, brand design, presentations and motion graphics.


This role is perfect for someone who loves blending design, animation and smart use of AI to create scroll-stopping, brand-aligned content. If you’re detail-oriented, enjoy working across formats, collaborate well with a creative team and thrive in a fast-paced environment, you’ll fit right in.


What you’ll do

  • Familiarity with AI or automation tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Runway and Midjourney).
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with tight timelines and evolving briefs.
  • A collaborative mindset, strong attention to detail and an ability to embrace and act on feedback.
  • Clear and confident communication in English, with the ability to explain design decisions and collaborate effectively with both creatives and project managers.


Why join SoCreative?

We help brands like American Express, Johnson & Johnson, Google, Schneider Electric and Toyota scale video and design content with speed, consistency and creativity. We’re a creative company built for quality and flexibility — powered by smart tech, streamlined systems and a global network of top-tier talent.


You’ll join a supportive, fast-moving team that values clear communication, creative thinking and getting things done. If you’re eager to grow, take initiative and be part of a modern creative operation — we’d love to hear from you.

title: Engenheiro de Dados
description:
Sobre a Volpi

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!


O desafio

Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
  • Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ;
  • Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
  • Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
  • Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) ;
  • Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
  • Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.


Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
  • Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
  • Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
  • Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.



Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação

title: Head of Data Science
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The Head of Data Science will be responsible for defining the strategic vision, leading the development, and overseeing the deployment of advanced machine learning models and data-driven products. This senior role will specifically focus on student audience segmentation, predictive propensity modeling, and AI-enabled career advising. The Head of Data Science will manage a team of data scientists and engineers, directing the creation and maintenance of robust, scalable data pipelines and analytical solutions to significantly enhance student engagement, career outcomes, and overall institutional effectiveness.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Data Science Strategy and Team Leadership
  • Lead, mentor, and manage a team of ML/Data Scientists, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Define the technical roadmap and best practices for all data science initiatives, focusing on model reliability, fairness, and interpretability.
  • Direct the design, development, and implementation of high-impact data products, especially those focused on segmentation and propensity models.
  • Advanced Model and Algorithm Development
  • Design, develop, and implement machine learning models and algorithms for complex student audience analysis and AI-enabled career advising, with a strong focus on predicting student behavior and optimizing engagement strategies.
  • Oversee the utilization of advanced machine learning techniques, including predictive modeling, recommendation systems, and natural language processing.
  • Establish rigorous processes for model evaluation, optimization, and monitoring in production environments.
  • Develop and maintain robust, scalable data pipelines to support all phases of the ML lifecycle.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Communication
  • Serve as the primary technical conduit among executive business leads, product management, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, strategic reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation.
  • Drive the adoption of new data science capabilities and gather feedback for continuous strategic alignment.
  • Release and Change Management
  • Coordinate comprehensive release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for ML model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered effectively.
  • Track and report on post-release issues, adoption metrics, and stabilization progress.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Proven ability to set technical direction, produce high-quality work, manage autonomously, and take strategic initiative.
  • Strong business acumen with unwavering ethics and a willingness to lead by example.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and executive roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements at a strategic level.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in machine learning engineering, data science, or a related analytical/leadership role within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing and mentoring a team of data scientists or ML engineers.
  • Expert-level experience building and deploying segmentation and propensity models in a commercial setting.
  • Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).
  • Experience with data manipulation and analysis using Python (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).
  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., BigQuery, Redshift, GCS, S3).
  • Proficiency in SQL for complex data querying and manipulation.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers (e.g., GitHub, BitBucket, GitLab).
  • Deep understanding of statistical analysis, experimental design, and A/B testing methodologies.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with media modeling audiences and digital lookalike techniques.
  • Experience with natural language processing (NLP) techniques and tools.
  • Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Matplotlib, Seaborn).
  • Knowledge of educational technology or career development domains.


Credentials and Experience:

  • PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: UX Research Analyst
description:
This role is 100% remote. Candidates must be able to work cross-over hours with the US. Candidates MUST also be fluent in English.


Pulse Labs is empowering insights and elevating experiences for the world's top technology companies. Backed by investors including Google and Amazon, we're revolutionizing product development delivering human-centered, actionable insights at every stage of the product lifecycle from inception to market release and beyond. We empower top tech companies to create and refine paradigm-shifting mobile, smart home, and AI products.


If you thrive in a fast-paced multi-project environment and love analyzing qualitative data, then you're a perfect fit. You'll work directly with our researchers to execute qualitative research projects such as diary studies, focus groups, IDIs, longitudinal panel studies, etc.


You will be a team-player who is an integral member of a talented and dedicated group of researchers working in a fast-paced, rapid-response environment where rigor and quality are paramount. Using Pulse Labs' proprietary tools and platforms, you’ll dive deep into rich video and survey data to analyze and interpret users’ interactions with and perceptions about next-gen products.


Key Responsibilities

  • Work closely with UX researchers to understand research projects, including customer requirements, timelines, analysis plan, and business goals.
  • Assist project team members with the logistical operations of the research program, such as maintaining research timelines, project schedules, question banks, data repositories, and other research-related artifacts.
  • Work closely with the operations team to make sure collected data matches the study requirements.
  • Ensure sound research methods while assisting with initial project plans, analyses, and creating final reports for clients.
  • Analyze responses from participant videos and transcripts, surveys, and other study data to develop key research findings and recommendations for clients.
  • Under the guidance of UX researchers, create deliverables for clients including scorecards, toplines, reports, and slide decks.
  • Develop high quality data visualizations, communicating data and findings cleanly, effectively, and efficiently.
  • Collaborate with the team and across the company to improve our internal processes.
  • Provide feedback to the Design and Engineering teams about how to improve our proprietary platform.


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in psychology, research methods, survey methodology, human computer interaction, sociology, or related field.
  • 2+ years of experience working as an analyst in a research setting or in a detail-oriented operations environment.
  • Knowledge of the end-to-end research lifecycle, including research methods/approaches and common analyses, specifically those related to UX.
  • Expertise with data collection, analysis, and interpretation.
  • Experience working on a team of researchers as well as alongside operations personnel in a rapid-response, often ambiguous environment.
  • Ability to recognize patterns and anomalies in qualitative and/or quantitative data.

title: Data Architect (Data Modeling & Optimization)
description:
About You

You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
  • Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
  • Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
  • Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
  • Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
  • Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
  • Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
  • Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
  • Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
  • Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
  • Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
  • Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Sales Executive - Subsea
description:
About M&O Partners

M&O Partners is a multi‑disciplined professional services company providing sales development, strategic and operational services to the energy and maritime industries, with a strong presence in Brazil’s offshore market. From Rio de Janeiro, M&O supports international subsea and offshore technology providers in winning new business with Brazilian operators, EPCIs and contractors through local technical sales expertise and structured sales representation.

Role Summary

  • The Sales Executive – Subsea is responsible for driving M&O Partners’ commercial development within the Brazilian subsea market, with a primary focus on acquiring new customers and opportunities for M&O’s supplier portfolio of subsea equipment, systems and digital solutions.
  • Reporting directly to the Senior Advisor – Subsea, the Sales Executive - Subsea will proactively identify prospects, open doors at target accounts, progress opportunities through the sales cycle, position M&O’s supplier portfolio and develop new client relationships with offshore operators, subsea contractors, and engineering companies.
  • The Sales Executive - Subsea will engage with key stakeholders across the Brazilian subsea value chain, providing technical insight and solution‑driven support to ensure client needs are met, supplier value is clearly articulated, and sales objectives are consistently achieved.
  • Success in this role is measured by new logos, qualified pipeline creation, closed new business and sustained satisfaction across M&O’s subsea supplier portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

New Business Hunting & Development

  • Proactively research, identify and prioritize target accounts in the Brazilian subsea ecosystem, including E&P operators, subsea contractors, EPCIs and engineering consultancies.
  • Execute structured outbound prospecting (calls, emails, LinkedIn, events) to secure first meetings with decision‑makers and influencers in engineering, operations, and supply chain.
  • Open and quality new relationships (“new logos”) for M&O in the subsea market, convert leads into commercial opportunities and manage the full sales process from prospecting to contract closure, handing over matured accounts for farming when appropriate.
  • Expand M&O’s reach among key players in the subsea market, ensuring ongoing engagement and account development.

Product & Solution Representation

  • Develop a strong technical understanding of subsea products and services in the M&O portfolio, including equipment, systems, intervention technologies and software used in subsea operations and integrity management.
  • Lead initial discovery and capability meetings, presenting supplier solutions and tailoring the value proposition to Brazilian subsea project needs.
  • Coordinate deeper technical discussions with supplier specialists while maintaining commercial ownership of the opportunity.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supplier innovations, certifications, and subsea industry standards.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Insight

  • Monitor Brazilian subsea project pipelines, pre‑salt developments, brownfield tiebacks and intervention campaigns to time outreach and proposals effectively with M&O’s supplier portfolio (RFIs, RFQs, RFPs).
  • Map competitive offerings and routes‑to‑market, identifying white space and differentiation angles for M&O’s supplier portfolio.
  • Provide structured insights on projects, competitors and customer requirements to the Senior Advisor - Subsea and M&O’s supplier portfolio to refine targeting and positioning.

Sales Process & Reporting

title: Sales & Trading Intern
description:
Sobre o Grupo BCP Securities

Fundada em 1989, a BCP Securities, Inc. é uma corretora e banco de investimento americano com foco em renda fixa em mercados emergentes. Com sede em Greenwich, Connecticut, e escritórios em cidades estratégicas como Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Cidade do México e Singapura, a BCP é referência global em soluções financeiras personalizadas. Reconhecida por sua excelência e compromisso ético, a empresa oferece serviços inovadores e eficazes para atender às necessidades de clientes ao redor do mundo.

Sobre a BCP DTVM

A BCP DTVM é uma instituição financeira voltada para originação, estruturação e distribuição de ativos financeiros, com destaque para crédito privado e operações estruturadas. Nossa atuação inclui uma mesa ativa de negociações no mercado secundário, promovendo liquidez e transparência para os clientes.

Expandindo do mercado offshore para o mercado local, a BCP DTVM combina expertise técnica e agilidade, atendendo empresas, investidores institucionais e family offices com soluções sólidas e inovadoras. Somos o lugar certo para profissionais que buscam um ambiente dinâmico e orientado a resultados, contribuindo para o futuro do mercado financeiro brasileiro.


Local de Trabalho : cidade do Rio de Janeiro, 100% presencial

Tipo de Contrato : estágio


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar a mesa de Sales & Trading no acompanhamento diário do mercado local de renda fixa, com foco em crédito privado (debêntures, CRIs, CRAs, notas comerciais e outros instrumentos).
  • Auxiliar na atualização e controle das posições da mesa, acompanhando marcação a mercado, preços, spreads e movimentações diárias.
  • Apoiar a equipe de Sales no atendimento a demandas de clientes institucionais, family offices e investidores profissionais, incluindo envio de cotações, informações de mercado e materiais de suporte.
  • Monitorar e organizar o pipeline de oportunidades no mercado secundário, contribuindo com a execução e acompanhamento de negociações.
  • Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios e “market updates” (diários e semanais), incluindo destaques do mercado, principais movimentos e níveis indicativos.
  • Utilizar sistemas internos e plataformas de mercado (ex.: Bloomberg, ANBIMA, B3, CETIP/NoMe/RTC, conforme aplicável) para consultas de preços, volumes e informações dos ativos.
  • Auxiliar na checagem de operações e interface com áreas de Middle/Backoffice, garantindo alinhamento entre negociação, registro e liquidação.
  • Organizar bases de dados, planilhas e controles internos, garantindo consistência e qualidade das informações.
  • Apoiar projetos de melhoria de processos e automação de rotinas (Excel/VBA/Python, quando aplicável).
  • Colaborar com o time na preparação de apresentações, materiais comerciais e documentos de apoio para reuniões com clientes.


Requisitos:

  • Cursando graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Interesse genuíno por mercado financeiro, especialmente renda fixa, crédito privado e macroeconomia local.
  • Excel intermediário/avançado (tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas, organização de bases).
  • Boa capacidade analítica, atenção a detalhes e perfil organizado.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com postura profissional para interação com áreas internas e clientes.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão, com agilidade e priorização em rotina de mesa.
  • Disponibilidade para estágio presencial na cidade do Rio de Janeiro (Ipanema).


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento básico de produtos de renda fixa (duration, curva, spread, marcação a mercado).
  • Familiaridade com Bloomberg e/ou plataformas de negociação.
  • Noções de VBA, Python, Power BI ou automação de relatórios.
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado.


Benefícios:

  • Bolsa Estágio
  • Oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa global com forte atuação no mercado de renda fixa.
  • Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e dinâmico.
